title: eludite.git.stash input
description: Stashes (Git Changes: Stash All, the Stashes list's Apply, Pop and Drop): `list` (default), `push` the local changes with a `message` (untracked files too with `include_untracked`), `apply` or `pop` stash `index` (default 0, the newest; a conflict stops as a merge does, with the conflicted paths, and `pop` keeps the stash), or `drop` it (class dangerous). The repository is the one discovered from the open workspace (solution folder or opened folder) upward, as `git` discovers it; without one the command fails naming eludite.git.init.
x-eludite-escalates: `push`, `apply` and `pop` are class execute; `drop` is dangerous.
